section_summary.extract_value: This Discussion section presents findings from a single study examining a model of body appreciation among college women. The model explored interpersonal barriers (adult attachment, caregiver eating messages) and intrapersonal factors (maladaptive and adaptive perfectionism) affecting body appreciation and its connections to intuitive eating and depressive symptoms. Body appreciation played a key mediational role, fully accounting for the relationship between discrepancy perfectionism and intuitive eating, and partially mediating links from attachment anxiety and restrictive caregiver messages to intuitive eating.
